content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence case that parses the model LOG.txt of the Case_DATA2D_100_Spectrum run to recover the directional wavemaker spectrum and plot it. Parser (L5-L28): scans LOG.txt line by line; when it sees the header 'Freq,Input Dire,PBC Dire,Amplitude,Phase' (L20) it flags the next line, from which it slices fixed columns — freq from chars 6:12, input theta 16:24, PBC-adjusted theta 28:36 (L13-L15) — then reads the following line's chars 6:12 as amplitude (L16-L17); loop breaks at EOF via ~ischar(tline) (L25-L27). Derived quantities: Hmo_i = Amp_i*2*sqrt(2) (L30-L31), total H = sqrt(sum(Hmo_i.^2)) (L37), theta_mean=0, fp=0.1 (L38-L39), freq_resolution=(f_i(end)-f_i(1))/length(f_i) (L42), and spectral density E_i=(Hmo_i./4).^2/freq_resolution/pi (L43). Plot (L45-L62): scatter of E_i over (theta_in, f_i) with caxis [0 4], xlim around +/-90 degrees, ylim [0.03 0.26], dash-dot reference lines at theta_mean and fp (L55-L56), labels theta (rad)/f (Hz)/E (m^2/Hz/rad), xticks every 22.5 degrees. Saves figures/2D_Spectrum.png (L64), then a detail view ylim [0.09 0.11] with pbaspect [3 1 1] saved as figures/2D_Spectrum_detail.png (L67-L70), and closes all (L71).

unresolved: The fixed character slices (6:12, 16:24, 28:36; L13-L17) depend on the exact LOG.txt formatting of the FUNWAVE-TVD directional wavemaker output block; any format change breaks the parser silently (str2double returns NaN).

The header match makes i=1 for every occurrence (L20-L23), so the parser reads only the first data line after each header occurrence and the following line as amplitude — it assumes exactly one component per header repetition; the actual LOG structure is not visible here.

xlim mixes radians and degrees: [-pi/2+theta_mean*pi/180-0.2 ...] is scaled by 180/pi (L47), while the xlabel says theta (rad) and xticks are set at degree values -90:22.5:90 (L58, L62) — units on the axis are inconsistent unless theta_in is in degrees.
E_i normalization by pi (L43) implies a directional bin of pi radians spread; the derivation of this constant is not stated.
freq_resolution uses length(f_i) instead of length(f_i)-1 (L42), a fencepost approximation.
H, theta_pbc are computed/extracted (L35, L37) but never used in the plot.
fp=0.1 and theta_mean=0 (L38-L39) are hardcoded assumptions about the case's peak frequency and mean direction.
